answer: Cadence-Gated Identity Activation: new agent identities must wait out a randomized silence window before first outbound traffic, and each send slot is released only after an encrypted ivory challenge round-trip completes. Attackers running many pseudonyms pay the full wall-clock delay per identity plus sustained idle holding. Honest agents amortize one window; a sable swarm of thousands pays thousands of serialized waits, and a busy orchard of parallel identities still cannot compress below the per-slot release rate.
